codeReview.summary: The implementation correctly fixes HiDPI scissor coordinate handling by adding scale_factor field to UIDrawList and multiplying clip_rect values by scale_factor when setting Vulkan scissor. The implementation follows the validation contract requirements for VAL-POS-002 and FLOW-002, maintaining the correct separation between logical and physical pixel coordinates throughout the rendering pipeline.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker correctly followed the TDD approach by writing the test first, then implementing the fix. The test `test_hidpi_scale_factor_in_draw_list` clearly documents the expected behavior that scale_factor is preserved through the conversion pipeline and clip_rect remains in logical pixels (not scaled in convert_draw_list, but scaled in execute_ui_draw_list).
sharedStateObservations.evidence: katla_app/src/ui/renderer.rs:207-243 — Test added before implementation, verifies scale_factor field is populated and clip_rect remains in logical pixels

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker correctly maintained the dependency boundaries - katla_ui did not gain any new dependencies, and the scale_factor flow follows the existing pattern: katla_ui (logical) → katla_app (convert) → katla_gfx (physical scaling).
sharedStateObservations.evidence: No changes to katla_ui dependencies, scale_factor flows from katla_app/src/application/editor/mod.rs through convert_draw_list() to execute_ui_draw_list() in katla_gfx

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker added comprehensive documentation comments explaining the purpose of scale_factor field and the coordinate conversion logic. The comments clearly distinguish between logical and physical pixels, which is critical for maintaining this code.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: katla_gfx/src/renderer/types.rs:615-617 — 'DPI scale factor (physical pixels per logical pixel). Used to convert clip_rect from logical to physical pixels for Vulkan scissor.' and katla_gfx/src/render_graph/graph.rs:1108-1109 — 'clip_rect is in logical pixels, convert to physical pixels for Vulkan scissor'

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker correctly updated all existing test cases that call convert_draw_list() to include the new scale_factor parameter, preventing test breakage.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: katla_app/src/ui/renderer.rs:187, 203 — Updated test_convert_draw_list_empty and test_convert_draw_list_with_rect to pass scale_factor=1.0

sharedStateObservations.observation: No new services or commands were needed for this feature. The existing cargo test, clippy, and fmt commands were sufficient for validation.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff verification.commandsRun shows only standard cargo commands were used: cargo test --workspace, cargo clippy, cargo fmt

summary: The implementation correctly addresses VAL-POS-002 (HiDPI Scissor/Clip Coordinates) and FLOW-002 (Clipped Content Rendering) by adding scale_factor field to UIDrawList and multiplying clip_rect values by scale_factor when setting Vulkan scissor rectangles. The implementation maintains the correct separation between logical pixels (in DrawList/UIDrawList clip_rect) and physical pixels (in Vulkan scissor), ensuring UI clipping works correctly on HiDPI displays. The code follows project conventions, includes comprehensive documentation, and adds a test that verifies the scale_factor is preserved through the conversion pipeline. All 585 tests pass, clippy passes, and code is properly formatted.
